rationale: A sudden, high-volume bullish impulse candle ($12.36 to $12.63 on 34k volume, roughly 2.5x the 5m ATR) has violently broken price back above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($12.51), violating the core short thesis of consolidation below the moving average. With the bid-ask spread now widened to 87.1 bps and price sitting just 5 cents below hard invalidation ($12.68), exiting immediately preserves capital rather than waiting for an inevitable stop-out. Flipping to long is avoided due to the excessively wide spread and overhead resistance at the $13.10 session VWAP.
